disclosures.reason: want-zero AllocsPerRun assert: Go's TypeByExtension lookup runs allocation-free, while the converted lookup counts 3 golib-site objects per run on windows and linux, on the case-insensitive miss: the 10-byte working buffer `array<byte> buf = new(10)` (mime/type.cs:123), the `(@string)lower` probe's string conversion (:140), and a third object not yet attributed (the sync.Map Load path is the candidate). Boxing is not counted, so the sync.Map probe's boxing is not part of the figure. Deferred, with no floor: both attributed objects are non-escaping storage that planned work removes; the entry retires only at zero bytes.
